headline: South Africa house party shooting kills at least 11
caption:
🇪🇸 Tres hombres armados abrieron fuego durante una fiesta en una casa en KwaMakhutha, cerca de Durban, Sudáfrica, la noche del 22 de septiembre. La policía informó que al menos 11 personas murieron y otras tres resultaron heridas. Las autoridades buscaban a tres sospechosos y dijeron que el motivo aún no estaba confirmado.

🇺🇸 Three armed men opened fire at a house party in KwaMakhutha near Durban, South Africa, on the night of September 22. Police said at least 11 people were killed and three others wounded. Authorities were searching for three suspects and said the motive had not yet been confirmed.

Sources: Reuters / AP — Sept. 23, 2026.
